title: librarian-graph-trees
intention: The librarian's spine: the graph-tree store as db_domain's first tenant. A node carries content + vector + provenance + standing; the deposit door refuses what cannot be traced; edges are DERIVED from vector proximity, never stored — 'the embedding IS the path through the graph trees.' Retrieval is a walk: nearest-by-cosine from a query vector, or the derived neighbors of a standing node.
why: Every one of the librarian's verbs (learn, summarize, chat) sits on this store — it is the one part with zero unmet dependencies today (db_domain seated, the embed seam seated, the library address ratified) and the part whose absence blocks all others. Akien's founding facts, settled 2026-07-22: 'the embedding IS the path' (edges derived from proximity — O(n) vectors, paths fall out); the librarian OWNS the graph (Law 6). And the extractor's discipline generalizes to the door: a node nobody can trace is fabricated attribution wearing a graph.
traces_to: Law 1 — deposited structure is the settled; a walk re-derives nothing (and a duplicate deposit writes nothing)
Law 3 — every node is born a hypothesis; standing is a field because tenure is a later measurement, not a birthright
Law 6 — librarian owns librarian_nodes; db_domain's owner-gate is the physics under the deposit door
Law 7 — refusals at the door are loud and complete; a walk of an empty tree is an honest empty, not an error
Law 8 — a hollow store (edges stored, provenance optional, dimensions unchecked) cannot pass the teeth

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees.py (13 teeth) under the tester's MEASURED netns seal — validations/test_librarian_trees.json, green, sealed; the proof needs postgres and the Unix socket crossed the seal (db_domain's documented asymmetry, exercised for real). Build gate: passed clean at the PROVEME exit (4 filters). Durability: committed + pushed.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: a deposit without provenance landing; a stored edge table appearing (the derived-edges claim gone hollow); a dimension mismatch answered instead of refused; a non-owner write landing; a deposit crossing without a breadcrumb. WRONG-SHAPE SIGNAL: if the store is live for weeks and every node still stands at 'hypothesis', the tenure loop never landed and standing is a decoration, not a measurement.
falsifier.horizon: re-read when the core loop (parent edge a) lands on top of it, or when scale pulls the proximity walk into the database (pgvector — filed edge).
